acip: GONG GI RTAGS GSUM PA MA GRUB NA, DNGOS PO CHOS CAN, KHYOD MA YIN ZHING MTSON BYA YIN PA'I GZHI MTHUN PA DU MA GRUB PAR THAL, SHES BYA DE YANG DE YIN, YOD PA DE YANG DE YIN PA'I PHYIR,
wylie: gong gi rtags gsum pa ma grub na, dngos po chos can, khyod ma yin zhing mtshon bya yin pa'i gzhi mthun pa du ma grub par thal, shes bya de yang de yin, yod pa de yang de yin pa'i phyir
english: Well, so I disagree with the third part of your previous reason: it is not the case that working things are such that there are many things which are not working things but which are still things to be defined. Suppose you do disagree. Let's consider working things. It is so the case that they are such that there are many things which are not working things, but which are still things to be defined, Because knowable things would be one example; while existence itself would be another.
